mapper.select: select a.id, a.title, a.content, a.category_id, a.create_time, c.name as category_name, u.name as author_name from article a left join category c on a.category_id = c.id left join user u on a.user_id = u.id where a.id = #{id}

select a.id, a.title,a.content, a.category_id, a.create_time, a.user_id, c.name as category_name, u.username as author_name from article a left join category c on a.category_id = c.id left join user u on a.user_id = u.id
and a.title like concat('%', #{query.title}, '%')
and a.category_id = #{query.categoryId}
order by a.create_time desc
